mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, description, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_role WHERE code = #{code} LIMIT 1
SELECT r.id, r.code, r.name, r.description, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.code ASC
